description: This PHP source file defines the GlobalConfigSubscriber class, which subscribes to HTTP request events in a Symfony-based framework to set configuration parameters based on query string parameters. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, handling internationalization and date formatting settings.

classes.name: GlobalConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class listening to kernel request events to set internationalization and date formatting configuration in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and associated callback methods that this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, retrieves query parameters, and sets configuration flags for internationalization and date formatting.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Privately used method to set a configuration key-value pair in the system, with error handling and logging.
